question: How is a finger unit derived from a twelve-part division?
premises: A whole is divided into twelve parts.
One of those parts is selected.
That selected part is called a finger.
inference: After dividing into twelve parts, one of those parts is taken as a finger unit.
uncertainties: The whole being divided is not explicitly named in this unit.
plain_english: Having divided it into twelve parts, one of them is taken as a finger.
